verdict.rationale: Heap documents a server-side bulk track endpoint that accepts an events array of up to 1000 events per request, which gives developers a first-party way to push events in batches. The evidence does not show that past timestamps are accepted for backfilling history, nor any importer or migration path from another analytics tool or a data export file. missing for 10: documented historical-timestamp backfill, import/migration tooling from other analytics tools or exports, independent corroboration of bulk import use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import historical events from another analytics tool or a data export into the platform

citations.quote: it takes an `events` array of objects with a max of 1000 events per request.
Use this API to send custom events and associated metadata to Heap that we do not automatically capture
